question: Does prior SOXX option put-share surprise add next five-session SOXX downside-risk information beyond lagged SOXX price, variance and share-volume features?
source_clock: Signal s at 09:46 uses only OCC put share from immediately preceding completed trading day s-1 and Qlib price/volume through s-1; position opportunity begins s+1 open. Retrospective original publication vintages are unproven; this screen is diagnostic regardless of score.

feature_formula.put_share: all-venue all-root put clearing quantity / (put + call clearing quantity); common 2x account-side factor cancels
feature_formula.put_surprise: put_share(s-1) - median(put_share(s-23)..put_share(s-2)), exactly 22 prior sessions; no missing-date compaction
baseline: SOXX close five-session return ending s-1
SOXX daily close-return realized standard deviation over 5 complete sessions ending s-1
same over 22 complete sessions ending s-1

label.primary: At signal s, SOXX actual Qlib open returns r_j = open[s+j+2]/open[s+j+1]-1 for j=0..4; y=1 if min over k=0..4 of product_{j=0..k}(1+r_j)-1 <= -0.06, else0. Require all five returns finite.
label.maturity: Open of s+6 plus one minute proxy; no label used before maturity.
label.economic_boundary: Open-based information label only; physical account and fees not inferred.

model.baseline_and_candidate: two fixed LogisticRegression fits with L2 C=1.0, no class weights, max_iter=1000; StandardScaler fit on train only

information_gate.paired_metric: Brier improvement = baseline squared probability error - candidate squared probability error on held dates

stops: Any source/provider hash, Qlib session or source availability mismatch stops before fitting
Missing or immature train/held labels stop; do not drop held dates or compact gaps
No threshold/sign/window/regularization adjustment from held outcomes
No promotion or economic account from reused market history or unqualified historical publication timing
